kmPerDay.why: Typical double-shift ride-hail duty; tuned so the Round-1 CNG baseline (₹26.9 L) is reproduced

productiveKmPerHour.why: Average urban ride-hail speed incl. pickups; converts minutes lost refuelling into km lost

paidShareBaseline.why: Round-1 baseline paid-km share; consistent with the Naive policy in the /vantage simulator

paidShareVantage.why: Round-1 target; reproduced by the VANTAGE policy in the seeded simulator (see RECONCILIATION.md)

farePerPaidKm.why: Effective revenue per paid km for a 6-seat XL-class ride incl. base fare, per-minute charge and airport/intercity premium (e.g. ₹100 base + ₹22/km + ₹2/min on a 10 km, 30 min trip ≈ ₹38/km)

driverShareOfNet.why: Revenue-share driver model: driver keeps 49% of fare net of commission (≈₹14.1/paid km); operator keeps the rest and bears all vehicle costs

downtimeCostPerDay.why: Lost operator contribution for each day the vehicle is off-road

cngPrice.why: Delhi ₹86.98 / Mumbai ₹89 in 2026; held roughly flat in real terms to 2035

bioCngPrice.why: CBG priced near fossil CNG under SATAT offtake; small premium assumed

petrolPrice.why: Current metro petrol ≈ ₹95–105/L; held flat in real terms

depotTariff.why: Fleet depot on commercial EV tariff + rooftop solar; state EV tariffs not independently verified — assumption

publicDcTariff.why: Public DC is ₹15–26/kWh in 2026; fleet-negotiated 2035 rate assumed lower

gridFactor2035.why: CEA weighted average 0.727 t/MWh (FY24); assumed to fall with renewables by 2035

cngCo2PerKg.why: Stoichiometric combustion of natural gas (≈ methane)

bioCngNetFactor.why: Bio-CNG well-to-wheel CO2 as a share of fossil CNG (biogenic carbon)

batteryKWh.why: Round-1 spec: LFP pack sized for one urban shift, not brochure range

maxCRate.why: Fast-charge LFP cell capability assumed for 2035 (aggressive but available today in premium cells)

dcAvgEfficiencyKw.why: Average power needed for 10→80% (16.8 kWh) in 20 min

cngTankKg.why: Two under-floor Type-IV cylinders (~90 L water capacity)

rangeExtenderKmPerKg.why: Series-hybrid generator at fixed efficient operating point

kWhPerKm.why: Battery-side consumption for a ~1.6 t compact MPV in mixed urban duty

lfpCycleLife.why: LFP to 80% SOH, typical datasheet range 3,000–6,000

powertrains.label: CNG (baseline)
powertrains.why: Ertiga-Tour-class CNG MPV (₹10.97 L, 26.08 km/kg ARAI, S22); 20 km/kg real-world (loaded, AC, city traffic); CNG queues ~40 min/day

powertrains.label: Bio-CNG
powertrains.why: Same vehicle as CNG; CBG outlets still scarce (132 plants vs 5,000 target, S15) so more queue time

powertrains.label: Petrol HEV
powertrains.why: Strong-hybrid MPV; petrol everywhere, but fuel cost per km highest

powertrains.label: Petrol PHEV
powertrains.why: 12 kWh plug-in: small EV window, carries two powertrains in a parallel layout

powertrains.label: BEV (40 kWh)
powertrains.why: Lowest ₹/km, but intercity/airport duty forces mid-shift public DC (queue + detour time) and highway coverage is thin

powertrains.label: SARATHI-X6 EREV
powertrains.why: 24 kWh LFP + CNG range-extender; depot charging overnight, one VANTAGE-scheduled DC top-up off-peak; CNG for highway

cityShare.why: Mixed fleet: 80% intra-city/commute km, 20% airport/intercity highway km

cagr2031to2035.why: Assumed deceleration after 2031 as market matures

rideHailingShare2035.why: Continued shift from offline taxi to app-based

segments.label: Intra-city on-demand
segments.why: Largest pool; intra-city P2P is 60.75% of trips (S3)

segments.label: Airport transfers
segments.why: Fastest-growing (19.14% CAGR, S3); luggage + surcharge yield

segments.label: Inter-city
segments.why: Long trips, high utilisation, low dead-km per trip
